planets.name: K2-24 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-24 with a 42.4-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-24 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-24. Its orbit and size follow Nascimbeni et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
